user.title: Asterisk AMI connection
user.description: Enter the connection details of the Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI). The connection is tested before it is saved.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Asterisk server.
data_description.port: Port the AMI listens on. The default is 5038.
data_description.username: AMI username, as configured in manager.conf.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Asterisk
reauth_confirm.description: The AMI refused the stored credentials for {host}. Enter the current username and password; the connection is tested before it is saved.

data_description.username: AMI username, as configured in manager.conf.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Asterisk server. Check the host, the port and your firewall. Details: {error}
error.invalid_auth: The AMI refused the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This Asterisk server is already configured.

init.title: Call classification
init.description: These settings tell an internal handset apart from a real external caller.

data.min_external_digits: Minimum digits for an external number

data_description.excluded_extensions: Comma separated list of extensions that are internal handsets, not external callers. A ringing channel from one of these is never reported as an incoming call.
data_description.min_external_digits: An extension with at least this many digits, dialed without a clearer Dial event to name the destination, is treated as an outgoing call to that number.
